mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (session_id, user_id, role, content, provider, model, token_in, token_out, status, latency_ms) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{provider}, #{model}, #{tokenIn}, #{tokenOut}, #{status}, #{latencyMs})
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, user_id, role, content, provider, model, token_in, token_out, status, latency_ms, created_at FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT t.id, t.session_id, t.user_id, t.role, t.content, t.provider, t.model, t.token_in, t.token_out, t.status, t.latency_ms, t.created_at FROM ( SELECT id, session_id, user_id, role, content, provider, model, token_in, token_out, status, latency_ms, created_at FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) t ORDER BY t.id ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId}
